Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Please send me a copy of [the Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](/book/62).[^1]
I have got some of the books I wanted for my article from a school inspector, but I am afraid my ideas are not much more definite than when I saw you as to what would be likely to be of use - as I fear there is no book on English education analogous to Mr Arnold’s on German and I can only pick up from all quarters[^2]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: With a note ‘Post 13/578, SH’.
[^2]: This projected article on English education, presumably for Macmillan\'s Magazine, does not seem to have been published.
